q: How do we count the alum, PAC and polyelectrolyte our water plant buys?
title: Water treatment chemicals: Scope 3
short: Coagulants and flocculants you buy are Scope 3 Category 1. Use kilograms bought from invoices and a supplier or named database factor for each. They are often small next to the plant's electricity, but auditors still expect them listed or a reason for leaving them out.
audience: ETP, STP and water plant operators

ul: Hypochlorite, lime and acid for pH.

p: If they are below your exclusion threshold, say so and show the estimate behind that decision.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
